summary: Enhance your skills with our DevOps and Continuous Integration Course. Learn best practices and tools to streamline your development process effectively.
lede: A DevOps and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) course shows you how to connect software development and IT operations into a structured delivery system. You will learn to create automated build and deployment workflows, apply automated testing, and support frequent delivery while maintaining system stability. You will practise building CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins®, containerizing microservices with Docker®, orchestrating clusters with Kubernetes®, and managing cloud resources with Terraform®. The course also covers declarative infrastructure provisioning, container lifecycle management, observability, and practical automation patterns that support the full software delivery lifecycle.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for technical professionals responsible for the speed, quality, and reliability of software delivery in modern enterprise environments.
audience: Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) focused on system
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of the Linux command line and basic shell scripting. Familiarity with at least one programming language and a general understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) is required. No prior experience with Jenkins®, Docker®, or Kubernetes® is necessary, as these will be covered from a practitioner perspective.
